This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 20.05.2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Müller
Industrietechnik GmbH, with its registered office at Berliner Allee 19, Stuttgart ("Party A"), and Schwarzwald Medizintechnik AG, with its
registered office at Hauptstraße 42, Köln ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signatures

Party A    Müller Industrietechnik GmbH / Anna Weber
Party B    Schwarzwald Medizintechnik AG / Anna Weber
Date       20.05.2026
